topic: A neighbor asks to use part of the yard for a garden
text: Hey, I just got this request from our neighbor, Alex, about using a bit of our yard for a garden. I mean, they seem really excited about it, and I don't know. It's just a lot to take in, you know? What if it messes up the yard or something? But it’s Alex, and they’ve always been so kind. They promised to take care of everything, and said it would be beautiful, maybe even share some of the harvest. It’s just, I don’t know. It feels like a big decision. What do you think I should do?
